details: The ResizeObserver fires render() on every integer-pixel width change with no debounce or requestAnimationFrame coalescing — during a drag-resize this can trigger 60+ full DOM joins per second, though the named transition ('main') mitigates mid-flight snap by auto-interrupting prior transitions. All other interaction patterns are sound: scales are re-created locally on each render (no stale closure risk), unified Pointer Events replace separate mouse/touch handlers, and there are no cross-view dispatchers that could loop.
